item: Federal deadline: last day to submit the 2026-27 FAFSA
notes: Source says the federal FAFSA deadline is June 30 for each academic year. The 2026-27 award year runs July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027. School and state deadlines are usually earlier.

item: Example MAP priority date: returning MAP recipients file the FAFSA or Alternative Application by this date

item: Priority access date for returning MAP recipients (2026-27)
notes: Returning MAP recipients who applied by this date get priority access to MAP funds. Applying after it does not disqualify a student if funds remain.

item: Last day to apply for 2026-27 MAP before awards go into suspense (waiting list)

item: 2026-27 Alternative Application closed; no more applications accepted for 2026-27
notes: ISAC notice: the 2026-27 Alternative Application is no longer available.

item: Court ruling: undocumented students no longer eligible for ISAC financial assistance for 2026-27
notes: Notice published on isac.org: a federal district court ruled on this date; students who submitted the 2026-27 Alternative Application cannot be considered for any ISAC program for 2026-27.
